senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Parva, name of a Persian builder and magian, from whom a compartment in the Temple was supposed to have been named: לִשְׁכַּת הַפּ׳ or בֵּית הַפַּ׳.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:3">Yoma III, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:6">6</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:20">Tosef. ib. I, 20</cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 35a:1">Yoma 35ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01980"><he>אַמְגּוּשָׁא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 62b">Ḥull. 62ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01608"><he>פַּרְוָא</he></cite>. [Our w. is perh. identical with <cite ref="Q01638"><he>פַּרְוָור</he></cite>.]
